```{r}
AddRegionToMetadata <- function(xenobj, cells.use, ROI.name){
  # This function accepts a Seurat v5 Xenium spatial object (xenobj)
  # and a vector of cell names (cells.use) corresponding to a region of interest
  # Adds a metadata variable to the xenium object called ROI
  # Cells corresponding to the vector will get a name specified in ROI.name
  # All other cells will be called 'other'
  # Returns a v5 Xenium object.
  presence.list <- rownames(xenobj[[]]) %in% cells.use # returns vector of TRUE or FALSE
  ROI.list <- lapply(presence.list, function(in.ROI){
    if(in.ROI) return(ROI.name)
    else return('other')
  })
  xenobj[['ROI']] <- unlist(ROI.list) # stash result in the metadata
  return(xenobj)
}

SubsetXenByCellNames <- function(xenobj, cells.use){
  # This function accepts a Seurat v5 Xenium spatial object (xenobj)
  # and a vector of cell names (cells.use) corresponding to a region of interest
  # does an internal metadata add, then subsets based on metadata
  # returns a v5 Xenium object
  xenobj[['In.ROI']] <- as.character(rownames(xenobj[[]]) %in% cells.use)
  newXenObj <- subset(xenobj, subset = In.ROI == 'TRUE')
  return(newXenObj)
}
```
